findings.obs_text: A negator reaches the thinking itself in Mat 5:17, Mat 10:34, Joh 5:45, Act 17:29, Rom 12:3, 2Cor 11:16, Isa 10:7 and Lam 1:9: do not think, we ought not to think, let no one think, his heart does not so think, she took no thought. The view is forbidden or denied.
findings.grounds: Do not think that I have come

findings.obs_text: In Jos 22:28, 1Sa 20:26, 2Sa 5:6, Psa 10:4, Isa 55:8, Mic 4:12, Mat 6:7, Mat 22:16, Luk 12:51, Act 12:9, Rom 1:21, Jam 1:26 and the other verses of this group the negator stands in the quoted thought, in the content supposed, or on another verb of the sentence (know, honor, bridle, care, heap up, delay): it does not reach the thinking. Adjacency is not scope.
findings.grounds: the wicked does not seek him

findings.obs_text: Qualifiers give the moral quality of the thoughts: evil in Gen 6:5, Psa 56:5, Psa 64:5, Isa 59:7, Eze 38:10, Mat 9:4, Mat 15:19 and Mar 7:21; righteous against wicked in Pro 12:5 and Pro 15:26, upright in Pro 21:29, prudent in Pro 14:15, proud in Luk 1:51, futile in 1Cor 3:20, at ease in Job 12:5; in Phili 4:8 what is true, honorable, just and pure is what to think on, and in Heb 4:12 the word discerns the thoughts.
findings.grounds: every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil

findings.obs_text: Where thinking is a judgment, the qualifier gives the value judged: best in Num 36:6, good in 2Sa 3:19, 2Sa 18:27, Isa 39:8, Jer 40:4 and 1Cor 7:26, right in Jer 40:5 and 2Pe 1:13, necessary in Phili 2:25, incredible in Act 26:8, last in 1Cor 4:9, worse in Luk 13:2, Luk 13:4 and Heb 10:29, wise in 1Cor 3:18, spiritual in 1Cor 14:37, less honorable in 1Cor 12:23, more in Mat 20:10 and Phili 3:4, unclean in Rom 14:14. In Psa 40:5, Psa 92:5 and Dan 7:28 many, very and greatly measure the thoughts; in 1Cor 13:11 and Phili 3:15 child and mature name the mindedness.
findings.grounds: Let them marry whom they think best

findings.obs_text: In Gen 20:11, Gen 32:20, Judg 15:2, 1Sa 16:6, 2Ki 7:12, Isa 36:5, Dan 5:6, Luk 12:17, Joh 16:2, 1Cor 10:12, Eph 3:20 and the other verses of this group the qualifiers describe persons, places or acts around the thought (there, behind, younger, surely, hungry, alive, mere words, then, nowhere, whoever, lest, all): none qualifies the thinking itself.
